description: One signal and one level CV sent to four outputs, each output taking its own share of that CV, with a slew and a mute on every one

params.text: Sets that output's share of the level CV, -1 to 1; negative shares invert the CV, so one output can open as another closes
Sets how long that output's gain takes to reach a new level, from under a millisecond to about 0.6 seconds
Silences that output on each press and restores it on the next, fading over that output's slew time; the lamp beside it is lit while it is silent

inputs.text: The signal sent to all four outputs
The level all four outputs take their share of, 0-10V for silence to full; with nothing patched it counts as 10V, so the ratio knobs alone set the levels
Changes that output's share, added to its ratio knob at a fifth per volt and clamped to -1 to 1
Any voltage at or above 1V silences that output, on top of its mute button

outputs.text: That output's share of the signal: the input multiplied by the level CV and that output's ratio, slewed

notes: with nothing in the CV jack the module is four separate attenuverters on one signal; patching CV turns the four ratio knobs into shares of a single moving level

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
inputs.6:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
